svg.title: Red Breach F-04 Screening Administration Staff Preparation

g.text: RED BREACH / A1 DENSITY PASS / F-04
APPROVED | Screening built first → Administration + Staff Preparation planned
CONNECTED PLAN / EXISTING SHELL AND DOORS
Solid orange: main route, 3 m clear.
Dashed orange: optional visits and working aisles (2–3 m).
Dashed grey: overhead structure/services. Yellow: light housings.
All floors stay at 0 m. Orange is clearance shading, not a new recess.
Furniture, cabinets and equipment define bays; floor clutter stays controlled.
SCREENING / A CHECKPOINT YOU CAN READ
S1 Walk-through scan frame: 3 m wide, 2.8 m high inside.
S2 Baggage conveyor and scanner beside the walking lane.
S3–4 Operator station and observation / examination counter.
S5–8 Lockers, storage, cooling and inspection supplies.
S9 Wall readout; task lights, ducts and repeated structural ribs.
A1–5 Five paired desk pods, monitors and ten chair blocks.
A6–10 Filing, network cabinet and a distinct archive bay.
A11–12 Air unit and wall display.
A 3 m entry spine connects to 2 m working aisles.
Optional branch: visit and return through the same opening.
P1–2 Kit issue counter with staff space and storage behind.
P3–9 Changing benches, lockers and suit-cleaning equipment.
P10–12 Repair/fitting bench, seat and spare kit.
P13–20 Tool check, carts, supplies and outbound cases.
B1–4 Partial equipment backboards separate the work bays.
The 3 m route stays continuous through the offsets to A2.
SCREENING SECTION / KEEP THE PASSAGE GENEROUS
DENSITY GOAL: composed equipment, work areas and overhead structure; open floor has a circulation or working purpose.
F-04: Screening pilot built as layout 09. Administration and Staff Preparation remain planned. Registration is preserved.
